faq.question: Can I change my plan at any time?
faq.answer: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes will be reflected in your next billing cycle.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: Absolutely! We offer a 14-day free trial on all plans with no credit card required. You get full access to all features during the trial.

faq.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers for annual subscriptions.

faq.question: Do you offer discounts for annual plans?
faq.answer: Yes! Save 20% when you pay annually. For Enterprise plans, we offer custom pricing based on your specific requirements.

faq.question: What happens if I exceed my user limit?
faq.answer: We'll automatically upgrade your plan to accommodate additional users, or you can contact us to discuss a custom plan.

faq.question: Is support included in all plans?
faq.answer: Yes! All plans include support. Starter plans get email support, Professional plans get 24/7 priority support, and Enterprise plans get a dedicated success manager.
